risk_summary: The disclosure provides substantial quantitative detail on backlog, restructuring charges, tax rates, cash dividends, and segment exposure, but relies on optimistic forward-looking language around growth and cost savings. Key risks include pricing pressure, industry overcapacity, declining traditional paper markets, concentration in SAFRAN-related aerospace programs, restructuring execution, and tax-rate volatility.
